name: autonm-sticker-generator
description: Studio desain Windows untuk stiker, gambar, dan aset SVG.
author: Stikerin

scripts.desktop:dir: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && node scripts/build-image-worker.cjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64 && node scripts/clean-desktop.cjs
scripts.desktop:exe: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && node scripts/build-image-worker.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/clean-desktop.cjs
scripts.desktop:msi: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && node scripts/build-image-worker.cjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64 && node scripts/build-msi.cjs && node scripts/clean-desktop.cjs
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.cjs && node scripts/build-image-worker.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis dir --x64 && node scripts/build-msi.cjs && node scripts/clean-desktop.cjs
